caption: Candidate “the cat sat on the mat” against reference “the cat is on the mat”: 5 of 6 unigrams and 3 of 5 bigrams match, and equal lengths give BP = 1. So BLEU-2 = √(0.833333 × 0.6) = 0.707107, with the two clipped precisions multiplied, not added.

spec.title: BLEU-2 worked example
spec.aria: A flow of the BLEU-2 worked example for candidate “the cat sat on the mat” and reference “the cat is on the mat”: clipped unigram precision is 5/6, clipped bigram precision is 3/5, equal lengths give brevity penalty 1, and the geometric mean gives BLEU-2 = 0.707107.
